description: Replace the queued-only guard with an unreachable state so any job can be started
expected_violation: A running or completed job is restarted instead of rejected
violation_scenario: start_job(Job(id='j1', state='running')) sets state back to 'running' and raises nothing; a 'completed' job would likewise be restarted.
rationale: Guarding on a state the job never holds ('cancelled') lets a running or completed job be restarted, the smallest change that permits the illegal transition.
